ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based screening of all proposed directors, shareholders, and beneficial owners (at or above the 25% threshold) against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN and Non-SDN lists, EU consolidated sanctions lists, UK OFSI consolidated list, Australian DFAT consolidated list, and the Vanuatu domestic counter-terrorism list established under the Counter-Terrorism and Transnational Organized Crime Act No. 21 of 2005. PEP status (foreign and domestic) is determined under FATF Recommendation 12 definitions and triggers Enhanced Due Diligence, independent source-of-wealth verification, and senior management approval before incorporation filing proceeds. Screening results, risk ratings, and the full UBO register must be documented by the licensed Registered Agent and retained for at least five years after termination of the business relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Company Registry; name clearance is lodged electronically through a VFSC-licensed Registered Agent filing directly in the VFSC corporate registry system (www.vfsc.vu)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The proposed corporate name must be composed exclusively of English/Latin alphabet characters; no non-Roman script or diacritical marks are accepted, and any foreign-language name must be transliterated into Latin characters before submission. The name must end with 'Limited' or its approved abbreviation 'Ltd' and must not be identical or, in the Registrar's opinion, confusingly similar to any name already registered or reserved in either the International Companies Register or the domestic Companies Act [Cap 191] register.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon a name rejection, the applicant's licensed Registered Agent may file a formal Reconsideration Request with the VFSC Registrar within 14 calendar days of the rejection notice, attaching the rejection notice, corrected or alternative proposed names, and written legal submissions. The Registrar must issue a determination within 21 calendar days of filing. If the Registrar affirms the refusal, the applicant may apply for judicial review in the Supreme Court of Vanuatu under the Judicial Review Act No. 26 of 2001 within 28 days of the affirmation. A rejected applicant may simultaneously file up to two alternative names on the same reconsideration application. After the 30-day reservation window expires without registration, the reservation lapses automatically; reinstatement is at the Registrar's discretion and requires a new name clearance fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted. An International Company with non-resident ownership and no physical trading footprint is required only to maintain a registered office in Vanuatu at the address of its licensed Registered Agent. A virtual-office structure (agent address, online board communications, and remote digital operations) is commercially acceptable for a generative AI / LLM API platform, provided all statutory registers, UBO records, and books are accessible at the registered agent's office in Port Vila and the company does not hold a public financial-services license requiring local premises.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (estimated under 5% probability per annum for a passively managed, tax-exempt International Company transacting only in AI API token sales via Stripe and USDC). Unannounced physical inspections are directed principally at licensed registered agents and financial-services licensees; however, a physical inspection risk of approximately 15% per annum would apply if the company later obtains a VFSC financial-services license or files suspicious transaction reports.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap 222] of the Republic of Vanuatu, as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2009; relevant provisions include the incorporation, constitution, share capital, registered office, registered agent, and director/secretary notification requirements (Cap 222 ss. 4-14, ss. 26-31, ss. 37-45).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), International Companies Registry, PMB 9013, Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Registration of an International Company (VFSC Form IC-01) submitted with the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum authorised or paid-up capital is prescribed. Capital may be denominated in any currency, shares of no par value are permissible, and no escrow, deposit, or capital contribution requirement applies at incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) That the Memorandum and Articles of Association of the Company as presented to this meeting are ratified and adopted, and the Registrar of International Companies is authorised to issue the Certificate of Incorporation accordingly. (2) That the allotment of the issued ordinary shares set out in the register of members is approved, and the consideration received is accepted as fully satisfying the subscription obligations. (3) That the registered office at the office of the Company's licensed registered agent in Port Vila, Vanuatu, is adopted. (4) That [●] be and is hereby appointed the sole director and [●] be and is hereby appointed the company secretary, each to hold office until vacancy; and the secretary is authorised to arrange banking and licensing formalities.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies Registry, via a licensed Vanuatu Registered Agent.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The licensed registered agent submits a name reservation request to the VFSC together with certified KYC/AML packages of the ultimate beneficial owners, shareholders, and proposed directors. The proposed name must end in 'Limited', 'Corporation', or 'Ltd', must not be identical or undesirable within the meaning of the International Companies Act, and must not conflict with names on the VFSC register. VFSC issues approval or a requisition within the stated service standard.
required_dossiers: VFSC Name Reservation Request (Form IC-00)
Certified passport copy of each proposed shareholder and director
Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement dated within 3 months)
Bank or professional reference letter
Ownership chart and corporate register extract if a corporate shareholder is used
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a proposed name is refused or queried, the registered agent files a written response to the VFSC requisition within 14 calendar days, submits two alternative names, or applies for re-submission with an amended name; no additional fee is payable where the objection relates only to the name.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed VFSC Registered Agent acting as drafter and compliance filer.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent drafts the Memorandum and Articles of Association under the International Companies Act [Cap 222], prepares consents of the registered agent, director, and secretary, and schedules the initial allotment of ordinary shares. Each subscriber executes the constitution, and all execution pages are witnessed or notarized as required by the VFSC checklist.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association signed by each subscriber
Consent to Act as Registered Agent (VFSC form)
Consent to Act as Director and Secretary
Declaration of Compliance executed by the registered agent
Statement of authorised and issued capital with currency denomination
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If drafting deficiencies are identified, the agent amends the constitutional documents and circulates a replacement version for execution by each subscriber; a covering letter to VFSC accompanies any substitution made before registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies Registry, Port Vila (in-person window or registered agent electronic filing portal).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent files Form IC-01 together with the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association, consents, declaration of compliance, and pays the official registration fee of USD 250 to the VFSC. Only complete applications are accepted; any statutory discrepancy triggers a requisition. VFSC registers the company and returns stamped documents once processing is complete.
required_dossiers: VFSC Application for Registration of an International Company (Form IC-01)
Memorandum and Articles of Association (original and two copies)
Consent to Act as Registered Agent
Consents of director and secretary
Declaration of Compliance
Proof of payment of the registration fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where a requisition is issued, the registered agent must cure the deficiency within 14 calendar days by amending the application or lodging additional declarations; a fresh application with new fees is required only where the statutory particulars of the company have materially changed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Registry Entry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies Registry.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, VFSC issues the Certificate of Incorporation stating the corporate name, registration number, and date of incorporation, and opens the company's entry in the International Companies Register. The registered agent collects the certificate and verifies that the recorded particulars match the constitutional documents and the application.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation issued by VFSC
Extract from the International Companies Register
Receipt of registration fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains a clerical error in the company name, number, or date, the registered agent lodges a written rectification request with the original certificate; VFSC issues a corrected certificate within 5 business days without additional government fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Meeting, Share Allotment, and Statutory Registers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors convened by the licensed registered agent.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The directors adopt the first board resolution ratifying the incorporation, approving the allotment and subscription of issued shares, adopting the registered office, and appointing the company secretary. The company issues share certificates to the subscribers and opens the statutory registers of members, allotments, directors, secretary, and charges at the registered office.
required_dossiers: Minutes of the first board meeting or unanimous written resolution
Share certificates issued to each subscriber
Register of members and register of allotments
Register of directors and secretary
Continuation letter confirming the registered agent appointment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If board quorum fails, the constitution allows a unanimous written resolution signed by all directors; if execution delays persist, the registered agent circulates an adjourned meeting notice and obtains electronic consents.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Notice Filings and Corporate Housekeeping
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) and the licensed registered agent.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent files any required notice of appointment of directors and secretary within the statutory period, confirms the registered office address, executes the annual registered agent agreement, and maintains AML/KYC files for beneficial owners. The company is thereafter in good standing and eligible for its tax-exempt status under the International Companies Act.
required_dossiers: Statutory notice of director and secretary appointments
Registered office consent and registered agent agreement
Annual licence fee schedule and payment instructions
AML/KYC due diligence file for all beneficial owners and signatories
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late notice filings attract VFSC penalty tariffs; the registered agent files a remission application with a bona fide explanation of the delay, and pays any penalty assessed to preserve the company's good standing.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable - the International Company operates a cloud-based generative AI and LLM API platform with no physical manufacturing, processing plant, or production facility in Vanuatu; the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission remains the sole licensing authority for the corporate vehicle.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not required for the offshore International Company deriving income from outside Vanuatu. If, exceptionally, a physical branch or commercial office is established within a municipality, a Municipal Business Licence under the Municipalities Act [Cap 126] would be required from the Port Vila Municipal Council or the relevant local authority.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology, Geo-Hazards, Environment, Energy and Disaster Management, Republic of Vanuatu.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category C - Exempt. The proposed activity is an office-based digital service not listed under the prescribed activities of the Environment Act [Cap 283] and the Environmental Impact Assessment Regulations; no full EIA or preliminary environmental registration is triggered.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No point-source industrial discharge or combustion emissions arise from cloud-hosted API operations. Administrative office occupancy must connect to municipal wastewater reticulation and comply with the Environmental Quality Standards administered by DEPC; any electrical and electronic waste must be handled under the Vanuatu Waste Management Regulations, with zero VOC or particulate emission thresholds applicable to the digital service itself.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Clearance Certificate from the Vanuatu Fire and Rescue Service, structural and electrical inspection certificate from the Public Works Department, and an occupancy permit from the relevant municipal council are required only where a physical leased office is maintained. For a fully virtual operation, no physical workplace clearance is triggered; if staff are engaged in Vanuatu, the Department of Labour occupational health registration applies.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue Authority (VRA), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management (successor to the Department of Customs and Inland Revenue); official portal: https://www.vura.gov.vu. International-Company licensing and annual compliance: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), official portal: https://www.vfsc.vu.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: No TIN or VAT ID is issued for a Vanuatu International Company (IC). Procedure for a foreign-owned IC: (1) the foreign beneficial owner engages a VFSC-licensed registered agent; (2) the agent files the charter/memorandum and pays the statutory registration fee (no minimum capital and no residency requirement for shareholders); (3) VFSC issues the Certificate of Incorporation carrying the IC's registration number, which is the only statutory identifier for banking, Stripe onboarding, and contracts; (4) because the IC is statutorily exempt from income tax, withholding tax, capital gains tax, stamp duty and VAT (International Companies Act, Cap. 222), no application to the VRA is made and no TIN is generated; if a foreign bank or marketplace demands a tax reference, the IC obtains from VFSC/its registered agent a certificate or status letter confirming the exemption, or relies on the ATI/foreign tax form matched with the VFSC registration number.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None available. Vanuatu levies no corporate or personal income tax, so there are no check-the-box classifications, CFC regimes, or hybrid-mismatch elections. The IC's tax-exempt status is automatic and non-elective, conditioned solely on maintaining the IC's offshore restriction (no business with Vanuatu residents) and paying the annual VFSC registered-agent/imposition fees. The only structural election is initial incorporation form: an IC (exempt) vs. a domestic company under the Vanuatu Companies Act (which is within the domestic VAT ring once turnover exceeds the threshold); a domestic company may subsequently 'continue' as an IC, and vice versa, under Part 14 of the International Companies Act.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act No. 10 of 1998, as amended; administered by VRA; only turnover from goods/services supplied in Vanuatu is within the domestic VAT net, and an IC is statutorily excluded from making resident-facing supplies.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VT 10,000,000 (ten million Vanuatu Vatu) of taxable turnover in any 12-month period, triggering mandatory VAT registration; an International Company is exempt from VAT and therefore cannot and must not register, because its permitted overseas-facing supplies are outside the domestic taxable supply definition.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None in force. Vanuatu mandates no real-time fiscal clearance, Government e-invoicing API, machine-readable digital stamping, or continuous transaction controls. Customs declarations are lodged through the ASYCUDA World system and VAT/customs returns are filed electronically via the VRA EFACT portal, but no pre-clearance invoice authorization is required for AI/LLM API token supplies.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods and services are zero-rated at 0% under the direct-export rule of the VAT Act (goods/offshore services supplied to non-residents and consumed outside Vanuatu). For the AI/LLM API platform, each token or inference usage supplied to a non-resident customer (i) is supplied by an IC that is prohibited from trading with Vanuatu residents, and (ii) is wholly performed offshore (cloud endpoints, no on-island supply chain) and paid from abroad; accordingly, the supply is 'out of scope' and simultaneously qualifies for zero-rating treatment. Eligibility conditions: non-resident recipient with no Vanuatu establishment; payment received in foreign currency or offshore stablecoin settlement (e.g., USDC) into an offshore account; and preservation of the documentation bundle for at least seven years.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (ASYCUDA World clearance record) - required only for physical exports; for pure AI/LLM API digital services, replaced by an IC registered-agent confirmation that no goods declaration apply

Bill of Lading / Air Waybill - for physical equipment shipments; for digital services, substituted by the executed master subscription / API Terms of Service naming the non-resident customer and Vanuatu IC vendor
Inward Remittance Certificate or offshore bank/Stripe payout/USDC on-chain ledger proof - evidencing receipt of consideration from outside Vanuatu
Itemized commercial invoice bearing the IC's VFSC registration number and 'International Company' designation, with 0% VAT / 'No VAT' cartouche
API usage and token-consumption log tying each invoiced amount to actual AI inference volumes delivered to the non-resident customer
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Vanuatu has no exchange controls, so no statutory FX-repatriation deadline applies; the 180-day benchmark is applied conservatively as internal evidence of offshore export and payment. If a claim to zero-rating/out-of-scope is challenged, VRA may: (i) treat the supply as domestic taxable and assess 12.5% VAT on the full consideration, with a 25% late-payment penalty plus 1% monthly interest; (ii) retrospectively claw back input VAT credits and zero-rating benefits for the whole period of incorrect claims; and (iii) prosecute fraudulent export zero-rating (false customs declarations, forged Bills of Lading, forged remittance vouchers, or sham non-resident customer arrangements) as a criminal offence under the VAT Act and Customs Act — penalties range up to VT 1,000,000 fine and/or two years' imprisonment per false declaration, in addition to VFSC deregistration of the IC and disqualification of its registered agent for breach of the International Companies Act.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), Port Vila; banking supervision jointly with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) for non-bank financial institutions, International Companies registry, and Financial Dealers.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu Vatu (VUV) is freely convertible on both current and capital account. No exchange control act, no prior approval for dividend or profit remittance, and no restriction on non-resident holding of VUV/USD accounts. Capital account liberalization is de jure complete for International Companies. Practical friction originates exclusively from correspondent bank AML/OFAC screening and the thin USD/VUV spot liquidity, which is concentrated in ANZ, BSP, and BRED. USD-denominated treasury accounts are the operational priority for an AI API platform whose revenue rails are USD-denominated (Stripe) and USDC-denominated.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None imposed. Vanuatu maintains no statutory timeline for repatriation, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no surrender obligation to the RBV for export receipts or software/API service revenues. An International Company may retain 100% of USD proceeds offshore-class with no maturity benchmark or VUV conversion requirement, subject only to each commercial bank's internal enhanced due diligence thresholds.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific (BSP) Vanuatu Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account + Operational USD Account
Operational Account (VUV only; limited USD capability)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-Medium feasibility. Vanuatu currently issues no dedicated EMI (Electronic Money Institution) licence; offshore digital EMIs overwhelmingly decline VU-incorporated companies because of correspondent de-risking and absence of local RBV recognition. Stripe direct acquiring is unavailable for a VU International Company; indirect merchant-of-record rail is required. USDC treasury operations are viable only through a VFSC-registered Financial Dealer or an OECD-tier exchange custody partner performing on-chain KYC and source-of-funds attestation, with USD off-ramp into the BSP/ANZ USD account.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Mandatory interview under RBV AML Directives and the Banks Act 2017: at least one director or the beneficial owner must complete an in-person interview at the Port Vila branch or a remote video KYC session with notarized original documents couriered to the relationship manager. Remote opening without physical attendance is permitted on a case-by-case basis at BSP and ANZ under enhanced due diligence, provided the IC provides certified apostilled certificate of incorporation, VFSC beneficial ownership extract, and bank-standard source-of-wealth statement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Bearer shares, nominee director opacity, or undisclosed trust in the IC ownership chain
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: VFSC Register of Beneficial Ownership certificate; signed trust deed or declaration of trust naming settlor and protector; notarized incumbency certificate; corporate register extract showing no bearer instruments.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Jurisdictional red flags: sanction-adjacent passport, tax-haven nexus, or high-risk country of incorporation of ultimate parent
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Tax residence certificates for each beneficial owner; sworn source-of-wealth report; independent legal opinion confirming no OFAC/EU/UK sanctions nexus; three years of bank or brokerage statements evidencing lawful accumulation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Digital-asset exposure: USDC as a primary receivable rail triggers virtual-asset service provider scrutiny
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: VFSC Financial Dealer licence or exchange partner attestation; on-chain transaction monitoring policy; AML/CFT Program aligned with FATF Recommendation 15; proof that USDC conversion routes to a regulated custodian with segregated client funds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Rapid early-stage inbound wire volume from global AI customers to a newly incorporated, zero-revenue IC
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed API service agreements with named enterprise customers; itemized SaaS invoices and trialmeter billing reports; projected cash-flow model; escrow or payment-processor settlement statements reconciling each inbound wire to a contractual milestone.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route via SWIFT MT103 with purpose code 'Share capital subscription' or 'Intercompany working-capital loan' (OECD CRS attribution 5531/5532). No RBV exchange-control approval is required. Recommended protocol: shareholder resolution authorizing USD capital injection; certificate of incumbency; source-of-funds affidavit for wires above USD 50,000; VFSC beneficial ownership extract; banker's draft or verified digital-asset-to-fiat off-ramp statement when genesis funds originate in USDC. BSP capital escrow account must receive the injection before operational release.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary rail is SWIFT MT103 for operational disbursements: GPU cloud compute, model licensing, contractor payroll, and infrastructure procurement. For hardware acquisition (GPU servers, network equipment), a Commercial Documentary Letter of Credit under UCP 600 issued through the Vanuatu bank's New York correspondent is the permissible rail. VUV-denominated clearing runs through RBV's real-time gross settlement local scheme; USD clearing is routed via US correspondent banks under daily daylight liquidity limits. Crypto outbound settlements are confined to a VFSC-licensed Financial Dealer conducting USDC conversion with commercial invoices and blockchain attestation files.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain-vanilla USD/VUV spot executed through an authorized dealer (BSP, ANZ, BRED)
Outright USD/VUV forward contracts with a tenor up to 12 months; no active NDF market for VUV
Cross-currency swap (USD interest leg against VUV principal) with an RBV-licensed authorized bank
Zero-premium collar structures on USD/VUV available at bank discretion for corporates with minimum USD 1 million notional

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 calendar days after each anniversary of the date of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10% late penalty per month or part thereof; continued non-payment for 6 months triggers administrative strike-off of the company from the International Companies Register

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory audit for Vanuatu International Companies under the International Companies Act; audit becomes mandatory only if expressly required by the company's constitutional documents or by a shareholders' resolution
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No statutory accounting framework prescribed for International Companies; where accounts are prepared for management purposes, IFRS or Vanuatu Local GAAP may be used at the directors' discretion

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent must maintain a current register of beneficial owners and controllers and verify its accuracy at each anniversary of incorporation; any share transfer or change of beneficial ownership must be recorded immediately and signed confirmation of updated UBO particulars obtained from the directors

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not applicable (statutorily exempt); voluntary independent review USD 3,000 – 5,500

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% — Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax, no capital gains tax and no branch profits tax on International Companies
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Statutory exemption under the International Companies Act [Cap. 190]: a VU_IC is exempt from all Vanuatu income taxes, withholding taxes, stamp duties and exchange controls. AI/LLM API licensing, subscription and inference-usage revenue generated through the IC is effectively taxed at 0% in Vanuatu; distributions to non-resident shareholders are likewise tax-free

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: N/A — Vanuatu issues no corporate income tax return. A VU_IC is statutorily exempt under the International Companies Act; the sole mandatory annual filing is the VFSC Annual Return, submitted electronically by the licensed registered agent through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The VFSC Annual Return and prescribed fee are due within one month of each anniversary of incorporation; no CIT declaration, return or assessment exists for International Companies

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full legal name of the IC, VFSC registration number, date of incorporation and type of company
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use exact details as stated on the Certificate of Incorporation; complete in English; verify the registered agent before submission

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Vanuatu address of the licensed registered agent and the IC's registered office
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A VFSC-licensed registered agent is mandatory; no local physical office or resident director is required for the filing

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names, addresses, nationalities, share register and beneficial ownership particulars
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-residents may hold 100% of shares and act as sole director; beneficial ownership data is held by the agent and disclosed only under lawful request

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Certification that the IC has not carried on business in Vanuatu and has not derived Vanuatu-source income
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Maintain a defensible declaration: AI/LLM API sales to offshore end-users are offshore activity; any Vanuatu-resident customer or onshore commercial activity would jeopardise exempt status

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late VFSC Annual Return attracts escalating late fees, suspension and eventual strike-off; continued default triggers compulsory deregistration with corporate assets vesting in the State under the International Companies Act

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Business Licence Application / Renewal form under the Business Licences Act [Cap. 241]; filed with the relevant municipal revenue office (e.g., Port Vila Municipal Council) or provincial revenue authority
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Business licences operate on a calendar-year basis and must be renewed in January before trading in the new year; operating without a valid licence is unlawful

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: IC legal name, any trade name, and physical address
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the IC's exact registered name; the registered agent's Vanuatu address is acceptable as the contact address

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Precise description of activities: ISIC 6201 computer programming and related services; AI/LLM inference and API platform
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Describe the offshore SaaS/API model accurately so the licence is classified as an exporter / service business rather than a physical retail operation

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Projected gross revenue band determining the licence fee category
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident owners must disclose global billings in VUV equivalent; under-declaration to reduce the fee band constitutes a prosecutable false declaration

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and contact details of the director or manager responsible for licence compliance
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident director may be named; the designated person must remain reachable during Vanuatu business hours

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Operating without or beyond the scope of a business licence: fines up to VUV 100,000 plus continuing daily penalties; false turnover or ownership declarations attract higher fines and, in aggravated cases, imprisonment under the Business Licences Act

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VAT Return under the Value Added Tax Act, administered by the Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue Department; filed electronically through the tax authority portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Monthly for taxable suppliers; quarterly for eligible small registrants
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Return and payment are due by the last day of the calendar month following the end of the VAT period; exported AI services are zero-rated and generate nil output VAT

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 — Output tax on local supplies
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: VAT charged at the applicable statutory rate on taxable supplies consumed in Vanuatu
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: AI/LLM API tokens and subscription services sold to offshore customers are exported services zero-rated at 0%; retain contracts, IP addresses, and customer evidence to prove foreign recipients

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: VAT paid on Vanuatu business expenses such as hosting, local office costs and professional fees
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claim credits only for expenditures supporting Vanuatu-taxable or properly documented business activities

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 3 — Net VAT payable or refund
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Difference between output VAT and input tax credits
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A predominantly exporting IC will normally lodge nil VAT with supporting evidence; repeated nil declarations without substance records will attract audit scrutiny

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing and late payment surcharges plus statutory interest; failure to register or deliberate under-declaration: penalty of up to 150% of tax evaded, fines up to VUV 500,000, and imprisonment up to five years under the VAT Act

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Vanuatu imposes no withholding tax on dividends paid by an International Company to non-resident shareholders; profit repatriation is free of Vanuatu tax and exchange control
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no comprehensive double taxation agreement network, so no DTA relief application or TRC submission path exists for IC dividends. Where a home jurisdiction requires proof of Vanuatu tax status, the registered agent may obtain a Certificate of Non-Assessment / Tax Exemption from the Vanuatu tax authorities evidencing the IC's statutory exemption; this certificate is issued under the International Companies Act, not under a tax treaty
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory withholding on outbound royalties and interest; no treaty-reduced rates exist because Vanuatu has not concluded full DTAs. AI/LLM API licensing fees, inference usage revenues, intercompany royalties and connected-party interest paid by or to the IC are exempt from Vanuatu withholding tax; source-state tax, if any, is governed by the payer's domestic law

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory threshold exists because Vanuatu has no transfer-pricing legislation and no CIT base to protect; no Local File or Master File is legally mandated. Under OECD FHTP / BEPS peer review, an IC deriving geographically mobile income must nevertheless retain contemporaneous arm's-length pricing records; best-practice documentation threshold: related-party transactions exceeding VUV 50,000,000 (approx. USD 400,000) per annum should be documented with a TP policy, invoices, contracts, bank trail and substance file
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Following the OECD Forum on Harmful Tax Practices peer review and Vanuatu's international tax-good-governance commitments, an International Company carrying on a service business — including an AI/LLM API platform under ISIC 6201 — must demonstrate economic substance in Vanuatu proportionate to its activity: a physical office, qualified employees or engaged contractors, board meetings directed and managed in Vanuatu, genuine operating expenditure, and core income-generating activities performed from Vanuatu. Substance records (employment contracts, board minutes, client contracts, invoices, bank statements) must be maintained at the registered agent's office and updated annually; failure to maintain them exposes the IC to deregistration and adverse international listing measures

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Understating global AI platform revenue in the business licence turnover band, submitting false VFSC exempt-status declarations while serving Vanuatu-resident customers, or fabricating invoices to simulate zero-rated export services
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Monetary penalties of up to 150% of tax or fees evaded, statutory fines up to VUV 500,000, forfeiture of untaxed proceeds, and deregistration / compulsory strike-off of the IC under the International Companies Act [Cap. 190]
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, including non-residents, may be personally prosecuted for fraudulent declarations, ordered to make civil restitution for the revenue shortfall, barred from holding office, and imprisoned; travel bans may be imposed during criminal investigation

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a pure mailbox structure with no physical presence, no employees, no local expenditure, and no board oversight in Vanuatu while allocating AI/LLM API royalties and platform profits to the IC solely to exploit the 0% tax rate
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Compulsory deregistration, revocation of IC tax-exempt privileges, penalties under the International Companies Act, and adverse EU/OECD classification of Vanuatu; the IC may be struck off with assets forfeited to the State
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Corporate veil piercing: directors personally liable for unpaid obligations and restitution, disqualification from managing companies, removal from the VFSC register, and exposure to home-country tax assessments through automatic exchange of information

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Channeling crypto-assets (USDC) or card-processing proceeds through the IC to launder funds, conceal the ultimate beneficial owner, evade sanctions, or finance prohibited activities without an AML risk assessment, despite the Low_Risk_Standard tier of the AI API model
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal fines, seizure and confiscation of assets, and imprisonment under the Vanuatu AML/CFT framework; suspension or revocation of the registered agent's licence, IC listing by the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit, and FATF monitoring where systemic deficiencies arise
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Sole directors and shareholders are criminally liable for AML offences: long-term imprisonment, asset confiscation, travel bans, extradition exposure, and permanent bars on holding corporate office in Vanuatu or under mutual-assistance requests

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Stamp Duty and Corporate Facade Abuse
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the IC's exempt status to defraud creditors, to avoid stamp duty on share or asset transfers, or to disguise onshore Vanuatu commercial activity as offshore business
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Stamp duty reassessments with penalty and interest, fines for fraudulent dealings under the Stamp Duties Act, invalidation of the offending instrument, and winding-up petitions initiated by the VFSC
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors held civilly liable to defrauded creditors and the revenue; veil-piercing applied where the IC is a mere facade; compensation orders, fines, and imprisonment for fraudulent misuse of the corporate form
